title: Building a template: the follow-up switch and the answer blocks
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  • A template with a checkbox field.
  • The field's response-options section is open.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the checkbox field offers a toggle 'Add follow-up to a response', sitting below 'Include Monitor option' and off by default.
2. With the toggle off, confirm the response options section is exactly as today apart from that one row.
3. Turn the toggle on and confirm each response becomes a block carrying its response row, a checkbox 'Follow-up for this response', a text area, and an Attach File control.
4. Confirm the text area and attach control are rendered and disabled until the checkbox is checked (not revealed only on check), and a follow-up is one text and at most one file (no second file, no list).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A checkbox field offers a toggle, "Add follow-up to a response", sitting below "Include Monitor option" and off by default.
  • While the toggle is off, the response options section is exactly as it is today apart from that one row.
  • While the toggle is on, each response becomes a block carrying its response row, a checkbox reading "Follow-up for this response", a text area, and an Attach File control.
  • The text area and the attach control are shown but disabled until the checkbox is checked, so the author sees what a follow-up consists of before committing to one.
  • A follow-up is one text and at most one file — there is no second file and no list.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-10243 (S19 — Conditional follow-up on a checkbox response); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S19; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S19-R1: “A checkbox field will offer a toggle, "Add follow-up to a response", sitting below "Include Monitor option" and off by default”
  • S19-R2: “While the toggle is off, the response options section is exactly as it is today apart from that one row”
  • S19-R3: “While the toggle is on, each response becomes a block carrying its response row, a checkbox reading "Follow-up for this response", a text area, and an Attach File control”
  • S19-R4: “The text area and the attach control will be rendered and disabled until the checkbox is checked, so the author sees what a follow-up consists of before committing to one. They will not be revealed only on check”
  • S19-R5: “A follow-up is one text and at most one file. There is no second file and no list”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
